_comment: Ledger for npm run daily:viral. V01-V06 are source:'seed-existing' -- history only, never regenerated as compositions (they live in src/viral/templates.ts, hand-authored, locked). Everything V07+ is source:'weekly-plan-w1' (days 1-7, hand-authored) or 'algorithmic' (day 8+, picked by scripts/daily-viral.mjs). Dates for V01-V06 are backfilled placeholders -- correct them if you have the real post dates, it only affects 21-day no-repeat math.

videos.title: 5s Don't Get Bored
videos.whyComment: Identity hooks trigger self-recognition — the restless/adaptable framing is highly relatable and begs a yes/no comment plus tags to friends who fit.
videos.tiktokCaption: 5s don't get bored — they outgrow things fast, and it's not the same problem. Are you a 5? Comment your birth date 👇
videos.instagramCaption: Born on the 5th, 14th or 23rd? Your Moolank is 5, ruled by Mercury — quick, adaptable, built for business, and allergic to staying in one lane too long. What gets called restless in a 5 is usually just a mind that's already three steps ahead. Are you a 5? Comment your birth date below 👇

videos.title: Your Birth Date Holds Two Numbers
videos.whyComment: Opens an unresolved gap ('you only know one') — the only way to close it is to hand over data in the comments.
videos.tiktokCaption: Your birth date holds two numbers, not one — and you probably only know the first. Comment your full date and I'll find both 👇
videos.instagramCaption: Most people know their Moolank — the number from the day you were born. Fewer know their Bhagyank, calculated from the whole date, which can pull in a completely different direction. That disagreement between the two is often where the 'I want two opposite things' feeling comes from. Comment your full birth date below and I'll break down both 👇
